text: Squeeze a balloon unevenly. One side bulges, the other flattens. Uneven squeezing is shear. Torsion, the spin made spacetime twist, and shear change at the same rate as the universe changes size. The on-screen scale stays level. Their ratio, the comparison between them, is frozen. The bounce neither smooths nor creates lopsidedness. Any lasting memory depends on particle production, the creation of new particles, a step the papers assert but never derive. This is a condition, not a signal size. Can a real cosmic fossil hear anything this chain leaves behind?
